_about: 结印 — hand seals at the camera, a prototype (Hanli 2026-10-21: 「做一个测试一下, 好玩的话, 可以在守墙里面, 让用户结印发火弹帮忙打怪」; 「没摄像头时, 就不用用户结印帮打」). The player makes seals at the Mac's or phone's camera; MediaPipe's Hand Landmarker (vendored, scripts/vendor/mediapipe/) gives 21 points a hand, all on the device; the seals are judged by the RULES below (games/jieyin/judge.js), never by a model. No camera → 结印 is not offered at all. 游戏厅 only; not in the story. doc/games.md § 结印.
_rules: A seal is held by ONE hand (either hand; the judge reads shape, not left/right). `ext`: fingers straight out (tip farther from the wrist than its middle joint by `judge.ext`); `curl`: fingers folded (tip nearer the wrist than its middle joint × `judge.curl`); `near`: two points touching (closer than `judge.near` hand-lengths — a hand-length is wrist → middle-finger root); `far`: two points apart (farther than `judge.far`). Points: wrist, thumb|index|middle|ring|pinky . mcp|pip|dip|tip (the thumb's are cmc · mcp · ip · tip). The 掐诀 canon is 古六's (褚先生): the thumb is the 门闩, where it presses the 文 opens — 巳 the index tip, 午 the middle tip (火), 申 the little-finger tip. `nearest`: [point, joint, [neighbours]] — the point within `judge.near` of the joint AND nearer it than every neighbour (掐诀 on a joint: joints sit 2 cm apart). `hands: 2` seals (the Mac's): `each` (or `a` and `b`, either hand either role) for each hand's shape, `between` for how the hands stand on the picture, in the larger hand's lengths (`judge.pair`): `near` · `far` · `above` [p, q] (p higher than q by more than `above`) · `level` (heights within `level`) · `column` (sideways within `column`); points `a.<point>` / `b.<point>`. `layout` only draws the icon and the tests' hands. Left out: 雷局 and a fist (the thumb inside or across the fist is a depth the points read poorly), 合十 and interlocked fingers (hands hide each other).

how.zh: 双手拇指尖相碰、食指尖相碰，围成一个三角，两掌分开
how.en: Thumb tips together and index tips together, a triangle between them, palms apart

hint.en: Fire is pointed; Li is fire.

how.zh: 双手推掌，并排、齐平，分开一拳多
how.en: Both palms out side by side, level, a fist or more apart

hint.en: Two palms at once: push the mountain.

how.zh: 双手都结剑诀，并排、齐平，分开
how.en: Both hands in the sword seal, side by side, level, apart

hint.en: A sword on each side, drawing the qi together.

how.zh: 一只手掌平放（指尖朝旁边），另一只手结剑诀，竖在它上方，别碰着
how.en: One hand flat, fingers pointing sideways; the other in the sword seal, upright above it, not touching

hint.en: One hand the stand, one hand the sword.

how.zh: 双手推掌，一上一下竖着叠，中间留空
how.en: Both palms out, one straight above the other, a gap between

hint.en: One palm for heaven, one for earth.

how.en: All five fingers open, palm to the camera

hint.zh: 他竖起一只手，五指张开。
hint.en: He raises one hand, all five fingers open.

how.zh: 食指中指并拢伸直，无名指小指弯下，拇指压住它们
how.en: Index and middle straight and together; ring and little finger folded under the thumb

hint.zh: 食指中指并着伸直，拇指压住无名指、小指的指甲——剑诀。
hint.en: Index and middle straight together, the thumb pressing the ring and little fingernails — the sword seal.

how.zh: 拇指尖掐食指尖，另外三指伸直
how.en: Thumb tip on the index tip; the other three straight

hint.zh: 顺着食指一节一节爬上去，到指尖是巳文。
hint.en: Up the index finger joint by joint — at its tip, the Si mark.

how.zh: 拇指尖掐中指尖，另外三指伸直
how.en: Thumb tip on the middle-finger tip; the other three straight

hint.zh: 火在南，南是午。火弹，掐午文。
hint.en: Fire is south, and south is Wu. For a fire shot, press the Wu mark.

how.zh: 拇指尖掐小指尖，另外三指伸直
how.en: Thumb tip on the little-finger tip; the other three straight

how.zh: 拇指尖掐无名指尖，另外三指伸直
how.en: Thumb tip on the ring-finger tip; the other three straight

hint.en: The middle tip is Wu; the ring tip, Wei.

how.zh: 拇指按在食指中间那个关节上，另外三指伸直
how.en: Thumb on the index finger's middle joint; the other three straight

hint.en: Wood is east: for the vine, press the Mao mark.

how.zh: 拇指按在中指中间那个关节上，另外三指伸直
how.en: Thumb on the middle finger's middle joint; the other three straight

hint.zh: 土在当中。这一节，书上叫玉清诀。
hint.en: Earth is the centre. This joint the book calls Jade Clarity.

how.zh: 拇指按在小指指尖下面那一节上，另外三指伸直
how.en: Thumb on the little finger's top joint, just below the tip; the other three straight

hint.en: Metal is west: for the blade, press the You mark.

how.zh: 掌心朝镜头，拇指横过掌心，按在无名指根上
how.en: Palm to the camera, thumb across it onto the root of the ring finger

hint.en: Water is north: for the ice spike, press the Zi mark.

how.zh: 只伸直食指，其余三指弯下，拇指压住它们
how.en: Only the index straight; the other three folded under the thumb

hint.en: The sword seal less one finger: the qi runs one line.

how.zh: 食指小指伸直，中指无名指弯下，拇指压住它们
how.en: Index and little finger straight; middle and ring folded under the thumb

hint.en: Two horns up, like a young ox.

lead.zh: 野猪拱到了山门下。四个印，照着下面一个一个结——最后一个是午文，午文一掐，火蛋就出手。结错一个，走火。
lead.en: A boar is at the gate. Four seals, one by one as shown below — the last is Wu; press Wu and the fire egg flies. One wrong seal and it fizzles.

title.en: The lecture hall · One seal at a time

levels._teach: The shape of 古六's teaching level (Hanli 10-21: 「古6教学结手印那里可以做教学关卡」; not in the story this round): one seal at a time, each with 褚先生's own line (`hint`), a wrong seal only tried again; then a `sequence` level casts the 火蛋.

lead.zh: 「手怎么走，气便怎么走。这个，叫掐诀。」褚先生把左手摊开，掌心冲着底下的人。
lead.en: “Where the hand goes, the qi goes. This is called pressing the marks.” Master Chu opens his left hand, palm to the room.

levels._about: Every seal this device may make, one at a time (the 游戏厅's way to try the library; not a story level).

lead.zh: 一个一个来：照着下面的手和字结印，稳住一下就算。
lead.en: One at a time: make the seal the hand and line below show, and hold it a moment.

_sets: Which seals a device may ask for (Hanli 10-21: 「mac上可以用双手, iPhone只有单手」): the first set whose `when` (a CSS media query) matches the page, else the last; `hands` the most a seal may need there. A phone held in one hand → one-hand seals only; a Mac/desktop → both. `?hands=1|2` on a dev page picks a set by hand count. Every move (`moves`) names a sequence for every set, so it can be cast on both.
